title: A high-order multi-scale method and its error analysis for nonlocal-in-time fractionally damped wave problems in composite materials
summary: Significant spatial heterogeneity and nonlocal history-dependent attenuation jointly govern wave propagation in composite materials, making full-scale direct numerical simulation (DNS) computationally prohibitive. This study proposed a high-order multi-scale (HOMS) method for nonlocal-in-time fractionally damped wave problems with highly oscillatory and discontinuous material coefficients. Using a multi-scale asymptotic expansion approach, the macroscopic homogenized equation, and first- and second-order correction terms are derived to construct the high-accuracy HOMS solution.
